design_notes: Use serif font throughout, single accent colour (e.g., deep blue), hairline rules between sections.
Tables should have minimal borders, alternating row shading for readability.
Pull quote should be set in a larger serif italic, with a thin rule above and below.
Sidebar should be boxed with a light background tint, placed alongside the offer section.
Industry snapshot stats should be displayed as a horizontal strip of three cards with bold numbers and small descriptors.
